kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Either from Middle Persian *čihrāzād⁠ (“noble lineage”) or from Classical Persian شَهْرْزَاد (šahrzād, “child of the city”).
s: Classical Persian شَهْرْزَاد (šahrzād, “child of the city”)
g: a female given name, Shahrazad, from Persian
Scheherazade, a character in One Thousand and One Nights
